parameters.label: Speech Threshold
parameters.helpText: Speech probability threshold used by TEN VAD. Higher values are less sensitive; lower values detect quieter speech. Backend valid range is 0 through 1.

parameters.label: Min Silence Frames
parameters.helpText: Number of consecutive silence frames before the backend marks speech ended. One frame is 10ms, so the default 20 frames is 200ms.

parameters.label: Min Speech Frames
parameters.helpText: Speech padding applied around detected speech boundaries. One frame is 10ms, so the default 8 frames is 80ms.
